passage.title: Shelly's Big Night
passage.text:
Shelly is a sea turtle. She spends almost her whole life swimming in the warm ocean, but one night each year she crawls up onto the sandy beach where she was born.

Shelly digs a deep hole in the sand with her back flippers and lays her eggs inside. Then she covers them up to keep them safe and warm, and slowly crawls back to the sea.

About two months later, the baby turtles hatch. They wriggle up out of the sand at night and scurry towards the brightest light they can see. On a dark beach, that is the moon and stars shining on the water, so they find their way to the sea.

But this year, bright lights from a new beach hut were shining the wrong way. “My babies might get lost!” said Shelly. The animals of Coconut Isles needed a plan.

mission.title: Lights Out for the Hatchlings
mission.goal: Help Shelly's babies find the sea and win a Tide Pearl piece!

intro.line: Hello, Sparky! My babies will hatch tonight, but a bright light is shining the wrong way.
Clack clack! The switch for that light is at the far end of the island, past lots of tricky spots!
Don't worry, Shelly. We'll turn it off before the babies wake up!
Thank you! First, read my story on the Story Stone, so you know how baby turtles find the sea.

beats.setup: Squawk! I can see the whole island from up here. Listen to my message and I'll lead the way!
beats.success: Squawk! That's right! This way, follow me!
beats.fail: Squawk? That's not what I said! Listen again.
beats.clue: Gully found the path past the palm trees

beats.setup: This driftwood sign got turned around by the waves. Answer a question about my story to fix it.
beats.success: The sign points the right way now!
beats.fail: Oh dear, it's still pointing out to sea. Let's read my story again.
beats.clue: The driftwood sign points to the light

beats.setup: Hrumph. I'm Old Barnacle, and I'm sitting on the path. Tell me what my sea words mean and I'll budge.
beats.success: Well done, young robot. I'll shuffle aside.
beats.fail: Hrumph, not quite. I'm staying right here.

beats.setup: Clack! The boardwalk lost its planks in the storm. Count with me and we'll build it back!
beats.success: Clack clack! The boardwalk is fixed. Scuttle across!
beats.fail: Oops! The planks floated away. Let's count again.

beats.setup: This seaweed rope has dried out in the sun. Use your science brain to make it strong again!
beats.success: It's wet and strong now! Up you go!
beats.fail: Oh no, it's still too dry. Think again, Sparky.
beats.clue: The seaweed rope is strong again

beats.setup: A pirate's chest with a pattern lock! Work out what comes next to open it.
beats.success: Click! Inside there's a clue: the switch is under the big palm!
beats.fail: Clunk. Still locked. Look at the pattern again.
beats.clue: The switch is under the big palm tree

beats.setup: The light switch box needs a password. Listen carefully and write it!
beats.success: The box is open! Quick, the switch is just ahead!
beats.fail: That's not it. Let's listen and try again.

finale.line: You turned off the light! Look, my babies are heading to the sea by the moonlight!
And there's an X in the sand! Dig, Sparky, dig!
A piece of the Tide Pearl! It's glowing like the moon!
